title: filingPartyType
content: Code for filing party type. 'FF' likely means Freight Forwarder.

title: filingFor
content: Indicates who the filing is done for. 'SELF' means filing party is filing for itself.

title: processingInformation
content: Processing information code. 'NEG' likely means Negotiable Bill of Lading.

title: isSplitBl
content: Indicates if Bill of Lading is split. 0 = No, 1 = Yes.

title: furtherConsolidation
content: Indicates further consolidation allowed. 1 = Yes.

title: movementType
content: Movement type code. '23' might represent CY-CFS or similar. Further context needed.

enum_map.23: Unknown - likely a standard movement type

title: serviceRequirement
content: Service requirement code. 1 = Yes (e.g., transport service required).

title: natureOfCargoCode
content: Nature of cargo code. '9' might indicate general cargo. Need industry standard mapping.

title: freightType
content: Freight payment type. 'P' likely means Prepaid.

title: containerStatus
content: Container status code. '1' likely means Full.

title: shipperSealTp, carrierSealTp, customsSealTp
content: Seal type codes. '1' may indicate a specific seal type (e.g., bolt seal).

title: handlingInstructions
content: Handling instructions code. 1 might indicate a standard handling instruction.

title: isDeleted
content: Soft delete flag. 'N' = Not deleted, 'Y' = Deleted.

title: packageType (equipment level)
content: Package type code at equipment level. 'CT-CARTON' likely means Carton.

title: packageType (item level)
content: Package type code at item level. 'CT' likely means Carton (abbreviated).

title: partySubType
content: Party subtype code. 'COM' likely means Commercial.

title: contactSubType
content: Contact subtype code. 'COM' likely means Commercial.

title: temperatureUnit
content: Temperature unit code. 'CEL' means Celsius.

title: blDate format
content: BL date is in ISO 8601 format with time (e.g., '2026-02-25T00:00:00Z'). May need to transform to other date formats.

metadata.transform_rule: Convert ISO 8601 to target format if needed

title: mblDate format
content: Master BL date is in date-only format (e.g., '2026-02-25'). No time component.

title: emirate
content: Emirate code for UAE. 'DU' likely means Dubai.

title: countryCode (two-letter)
content: Two-letter ISO country codes used in party details and items. 'AE' for United Arab Emirates, 'SG' for Singapore.

title: imoClass
content: IMO dangerous goods class. '1.1' indicates explosives with mass explosion hazard.

title: unCode
content: UN number for dangerous goods. '124' and '12' are example UN numbers.

title: Shipping Line Code Formation Rule
content: The system code for a shipping line is formed by appending 'SL00' to its three-letter abbreviation (e.g., PNS becomes PNSSL00). This mapping is used in API push integration.

metadata.transform_rule: Concatenate carrier_short_code with 'SL00' to form carrier_system_code.

title: wmsordst_1_qcus_code
content: Quality code set to fixed value 'T1'.

title: qnbr_number_code
content: Number code set to fixed value 'OLS' (order line number? ).

title: qref_custom_reference
content: Custom reference type set to fixed value 'PARTY'.

title: qdoc_code
content: Document code set to fixed value 'B/L' (Bill of Lading).

title: qloc_location_qual enum
content: Location qualifier: 'PLO' for Place of Loading, 'PDI' for Place of Discharge.

title: wmsordl3 structure
content: Line item container with fields: wmsordl3_line_number, wmsar_article_number, wmsordst_number_order, wmsordst_order_qmus_measure_code, warehouse location codes (wmswc, wmswa, wmswu, wmswl), lot_number_1, serial_number_1, storage options, stock status, quality code, weight and volume totals.

content: UN/LOCODE values: 'XGG' likely for a Chinese port (e.g., Xiamen? but code XGG is not standard; could be a custom code) and 'RTM' for Rotterdam.
